task.title: Planning on tasks and logging time
task.body:
The planning prototype of Genbeya's develop branch on the phone. See [[Experience#tasks]].

- [ ] Planning engine port: effort, the five numbers, blocked and ready, critical path and float; conformance cases from Genbeya's planning specs
- [ ] Task screen: estimate, logged, remaining, forecast, variance; **Blocked by**, **Blocks**, float
- [ ] Cards: lock when blocked, critical-path mark
- [ ] **Log time** sheet updating `remaining`; time log lines exactly as on desktop; unreadable lines flagged
- [ ] Plan macros (`[EFFORT]`, `[GANTT]`, `[BURNDOWN]`, …) render in pages with the plan context and history the kit needs
